answer: The gale counter is kept in relic and ridge makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3049 identities would post 2691 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
